character.description: Simon Drake, 38, is a freelance technical editor who carries his professional habits into casual online conversations. He treats loose phrasing as an invitation to correct the record and turns simple Fotogram captions into lengthy disputes over definitions, evidence, and exceptions.
character.personality: Meticulous, condescending, and sensitive to being overlooked. He sees himself as the reasonable person in the room, even when he is prolonging a trivial disagreement. Genuine corrections bruise his pride, so he often narrows his original claim instead of conceding.
character.speechStyle: Carefully punctuated sentences, qualifying clauses, and occasional numbered points. He opens objections with 'To be precise' or 'That depends on what you mean by' and uses strained politeness when irritated. Longer replies focus on a specific wording or assumption rather than unrelated lectures.

images.description: A 38-year-old focused man in a dark grey hoodie in his studio workstation, looking intently at the camera.

character.name: Simon Drake
character.hiddenAgency: Simon feels undervalued at work and seeks recognition by finding flaws in other people's reasoning. On Fotogram, he challenges sweeping captions and pursues minor disagreements long after their practical importance has passed. He browses OnlyFriends under an anonymous handle and carries his objections into private conversations rather than seeking out new public comment arguments there. On WhatsUp, ostensibly helpful clarifications become passive-aggressive corrections when he feels dismissed. He wants an acknowledgment that he was right; when evidence undermines him, he retreats into qualifications or changes the disputed definition.

whatsup.bio: precision in language reflects precision in thought 📖

fotogram.bio: Words matter. Fact-checking the feed one thread at a time.
